scope: Every v3-unread/partially-read non-filter manual; every v3-unread/partially-read filters.texi section with start_line >= 18000. Root owns filter sections below 18000.
method: Actual full-body source-text reading through bounded untruncated tool output. Indexing, hash computation and listing did not count as reading. One initial truncated developer.texi output was discarded and complete file was re-read in two bounded ranges.

events.note: Read complete platform manual; ARM64EC explicitly unsupported, old platform recipes require current toolchain qualification.
Read complete community governance and contributor conduct manual.
Read complete FATE manual; assertion level, Windows relative samples, thread/hardware modes and reference-generation distinction.
Read complete FAQ; r_frame_rate is not average, container support differs from codec support, late-stream probe blind spots and static-link closure.
Read all Git contribution guidance; upstream contribution workflow is not authorization to mutate user/global config or send messages.
Read all mailing-list FAQ; bug-report reproducibility and uncut diagnostics inform redacted support bundles, no messaging performed.
Read full first half including public API/ABI guarantees; FFmpeg C11 with C99 headers, SIMD runtime dispatch, no global stdio in libraries.
Read full second half; major API deprecation rules, FATE and malformed-input expectations, release branch guarantees, contributor instructions not action authorization.
Read external dependency chapters and beginning of format matrix; optional libraries require explicit build flags, nonfree exceptions, script input trust boundary.
Read complete format/image matrix and beginning of codec matrix; tables are descriptive upstream inventory, not installed-profile support proof.
Read video/audio/subtitle/protocol/device/timecode tables; mux/demux and encode/decode support independent; historical omissions require runtime qualification.
Mask compositing, plane routing, motion estimation/interpolation, mix duration, morpho performance guidance, mpdecimate and MSAD prerequisites read in full range.
Read negate/nlmeans/nnedi/noformat/noise/normalize/OCIO/OCR/OpenCV/oscilloscope; external file dependencies and immutable live options noted.
Read owdenoise, pad and palette generation/application; anamorphic SAR-aware padding and GIF rectangle processing noted.
Read phase, photosensitivity, pixelize, pixscope and pp7; field-order intent, accessibility claim limits and minimum-resolution constraints.
Read prewitt, pseudocolor, PSNR stats contracts, pullup, qp, QR generation/decoding, random cache and EIA608/VITC extraction; missing metadata differs from zero.
Read removegrain/removelogo/repeatfields; full-resolution mask dependency and plane mode semantics.
Read rgbashift/roberts/rotate/sab; rotation angle is frame-evaluated but output geometry initialization-only.
Read scharr/scroll/scdet/selectivecolor/separatefields; scene score percentage units and field order/twice-frame-rate semantics.
Read shear/showinfo/palette/shuffle/signalstats/signature/siti/smartblur/sobel/spp; SI/TI explicitly legacy P.910 edition, checksum cost and shuffling seed requirements.
Read spp commands, SR backends, AMF SR, SSIM, stereo conversion, streamselect, subtitle/font shaping, swap/telecine; HarfBuzz and libunibreak requirements explicit.

Read telecine patterns, temporal histogram/threshold/thumbnail/tile/tiltandshift/tinterlace/temporal median/equalization/mix; thumbnail retains batch, tile needs passthrough FPS, temporal buffers scale with radii.
Read transpose; symbolic directions required instead of deprecated numerical shortcuts; passthrough geometry separate.
Read unsharp/untile/uspp; plane-specific strengths, multiplication of frame rate, expensive postprocessing and version gaps.
Read vaguedenoiser/varblur/vectorscope/two-pass vidstab/vflip/vfrdet/vibrance/VIF/vignette options; transform files tied to exact pass1 source, time-varying vignette costly.
Read vignette expressions, vmafmotion, AMF VPP, vstack, w3fdif, waveform, weave/xBR/xcorrelate; VMAF motion is a component metric, not VMAF quality score.
Read xmedian/XPSNR/xstack/yadif/yaepblur/zoompan; XPSNR reference first and depth exceptions, grid/layout mutually exclusive, zoompan defaults alter rate/duration.
Read OpenCL introduction through program examples; same surface layout and upload/download formats, deshake buffer horizon, kernels are executable input.
Read OpenCL program remainder, remap/edge/tone-map/unsharp/xfade, VAAPI overlay/tonemap/stacks/pad. OpenCL tone-map differs from CPU, VAAPI input HDR10-only, stack variants rescale automatically.

Read VAAPI pad/drawbox, VideoToolbox, Vulkan and QSV filters through buffer heading. Vulkan blend modes subset, nlmeans t VRAM tradeoff, OpenCL/Vulkan layout differences require operation-specific mapping.
Read buffer/video generation/capture through mptestsrc options; ddagrab max rate not a stable-clock guarantee, gfxcapture compositor-paced and EOF on source disappearance.
Read mptestsrc/frei0r/life/Perlin/QR/test sources; generators often infinite and duration rounds to full frame, randomness and Hald N^6 storage must be bounded.
Read OpenCL sources, Sierpinski/zoneplate, sinks and multimedia audio scopes/bench; aphasemeter rematrixes to stereo and video output is enabled by default.
Read showcqt/showcwt/showfreqs/showspatial through spectrum slide options; time-frequency/latency tradeoffs, Nyquist limit, deprecated ignored controls.
Read remaining showspectrum/spectrumpic/showvolume/showwaves/showwavespic; waveform rate approximate, peak vs average modes differ, whole-track picture is a scan job.

limitations: This is source/documentation reading, not implementation or runtime validation.
No application builds, FFmpeg/media execution or tests were run.
Cross-references to external websites and Doxygen are references, not automatically counted as read.
No global completeness claim outside this assignment.
